# Softgrove

> Independent app studio making private, single-purpose tracking apps for iPhone.
> Every app: free core, no account, no ads; all data stays on the user's device
> (no cloud backend). Premium tiers add analysis and PDF reports.

## Apps
- [Skinote](https://softgrove.github.io/apps/skinote/): Track flares, find triggers — Eczema tracking; free core; Premium $6.99/mo or $39.99/yr. App Store id6782466803.
- [Settura](https://softgrove.github.io/apps/settura/): Find your trigger foods — IBS & gut tracking; free core; Premium $6.99/mo or $39.99/yr. App Store id6781145402.
- [RefluxLog](https://softgrove.github.io/apps/refluxlog/): Acid Reflux & Heartburn Diary — Acid reflux diary; free core; Premium $6.99/mo or $39.99/yr. App Store id6781159330.
- [GoutLog](https://softgrove.github.io/apps/goutlog/): Find your gout triggers — Gout & uric acid; free core; Premium $6.99/mo or $39.99/yr. App Store id6783216815.
- [NerveLog](https://softgrove.github.io/apps/nervelog/): Tingling, burning & numbness — Neuropathy tracking; free core; Premium $6.99/mo or $39.99/yr. App Store id6785813444.
- [PawLog](https://softgrove.github.io/apps/pawlog/): Never miss a vet or dose — Pet health records; free core; Premium $6.99/mo or $39.99/yr. App Store id6782466968.
- [PlantLog](https://softgrove.github.io/apps/plantlog/): Never forget to water — Plant care journal; free core; Premium $6.99/mo or $39.99/yr. App Store id6783232188.
- [MotorLog](https://softgrove.github.io/apps/motorlog/): Mileage, service & gas log — Car & fuel log; free core; Premium $6.99/mo or $39.99/yr. App Store id6781159313.
- [ReadLog](https://softgrove.github.io/apps/readlog/): Track every book you read — Reading journal; free core; Premium $6.99/mo or $39.99/yr. App Store id6781130239.
- [Coralog](https://softgrove.github.io/apps/coralog/): Reef tank & dosing tracker — Reef tank tracker; free core; Premium $6.99/mo or $39.99/yr. App Store id6786378477.
- [Boardcut](https://softgrove.github.io/apps/boardcut/): Plywood & sheet cut calculator — Cut list optimizer; free up to 10 pieces; full version $12.99 one-time. App Store id6787905177.

## Free printable templates (PDF, no sign-up)
- [Free Printable Eczema Tracker (PDF)](https://softgrove.github.io/templates/eczema-tracker-printable/): A free one-page printable eczema tracker. Log daily flares, itch severity, affected areas, and possible triggers — then bring a concrete record to your dermatologist.
- [Free Printable Car Maintenance Log (PDF)](https://softgrove.github.io/templates/car-maintenance-log-template/): A free one-page printable car maintenance log. Record every oil change, tire rotation, repair, and service with date, mileage, and cost — a clean history for taxes or resale.
- [Free Printable Gout Food Diary & Uric Acid Log (PDF)](https://softgrove.github.io/templates/gout-food-diary-printable/): A free one-page printable gout diary. Track meals and purine levels, uric acid readings, hydration, and flares — see your own pattern and bring a real record to your doctor.
- [Free Printable Eczema Food & Trigger Diary (PDF)](https://softgrove.github.io/templates/eczema-food-trigger-diary/): A free one-page eczema food and trigger diary. Log meals, personal care products, weather, and stress alongside daily itch and flare severity — then look for what shows up before your worse days.
- [Free Printable Dermatologist Visit Summary Sheet](https://softgrove.github.io/templates/dermatologist-visit-summary-sheet/): A free one-page dermatologist visit prep sheet. Summarize recent flares, current treatments, questions, and photos — walk into your appointment with a concrete record instead of a blank memory.
- [Free Printable Uric Acid Tracking Log (PDF)](https://softgrove.github.io/templates/uric-acid-tracking-log/): A free one-page printable uric acid log. Record every uric acid reading with date, source, medication, and any recent flare — turn scattered numbers into a trend your doctor can act on.
- [Free Printable Gout Attack Diary (PDF)](https://softgrove.github.io/templates/gout-attack-diary/): A free one-page printable gout attack diary. Record each flare — joint, severity, duration, what preceded it — and start seeing the pattern of what sets yours off.
- [Free Printable Fuel Economy Tracking Sheet (PDF)](https://softgrove.github.io/templates/fuel-economy-tracking-sheet/): A free one-page printable gas mileage log. Record every fill-up — date, odometer, gallons, cost — and compute MPG yourself with the built-in space. See when your fuel economy drifts.
- [Free Printable Vehicle Service Checklist (PDF)](https://softgrove.github.io/templates/vehicle-service-checklist/): A free one-page printable vehicle service checklist. Common maintenance items with typical intervals — check off what's done, note when, and never wonder if the coolant is overdue again.
- [Free Printable Symptom Tracker Template (PDF)](https://softgrove.github.io/templates/symptom-tracker-template/): A free general-purpose printable symptom tracker. Log daily symptom severity, timing, and possible triggers for any condition — bring a dated record to your next doctor's visit instead of relying on memory.

## Facts
- All apps are iPhone (iOS). Data is stored on-device only; no account exists.
- Health apps are journaling tools, not medical devices; they do not give medical advice.
- Developer page: https://apps.apple.com/developer/id6781130241
